name: Plateau pressure > 30 cmH2O
description: Cumulative duration with alveolar overdistension risk (Pplat > 30 cmH2O).
source: ARDS Network. Ventilation with lower tidal volumes as compared with traditional tidal volumes for acute lung injury and ARDS. N Engl J Med 2000;342:1301-8; ESICM ARDS Guidelines 2023.

name: Driving pressure > 15 cmH2O
description: Cumulative duration with elevated cyclical lung strain (ΔP = Pplat - PEEP > 15 cmH2O).
source: Amato MBP, et al. Driving pressure and survival in the acute respiratory distress syndrome. N Engl J Med 2015;372:747-55.

name: Tidal volume > 8 mL/kg PBW
description: Cumulative duration with excessive tidal volume on invasive ventilation (> 8 mL/kg predicted body weight).
source: ARDS Network. N Engl J Med 2000;342:1301-8; Acute Respiratory Distress Syndrome: The Berlin Definition. JAMA 2012;307:2526-33.

name: FiO2 > 0.6 while SpO2 > 96%
description: Cumulative duration with avoidable high oxygen exposure causing reactive oxygen species injury and absorption atelectasis risk.
source: Chu DK, et al. Mortality and morbidity in acutely ill adults treated with liberal versus conservative oxygen therapy (IOTA): a systematic review and meta-analysis. Lancet 2018;391:1693-705; BTS Emergency Oxygen Guideline 2017.

name: SpO2 < 88%
description: Cumulative duration in severe arterial hypoxaemia below the steep inflexion of the oxygen dissociation curve.
source: ARDS Network ARMA protocol targets (SpO2 88-95%); ESICM ARDS Guidelines 2023.
